title: ores and stuff
description: my mod adds lots of new ores and items and tools.
body:
my mod adds lots of new ores and items and tools magic ores are overpowered but are super rare, jello is the best food in the game but its hard to make you will need a pot and brewing stand and a fridge if you wanna eat jello not scalding hot jello, Redstone tools are here and they have ability's because Redstone is useful the tools must be too, ore biome is a "joke biome" made for fun it has everything replaced with ores like the dirt or leaves and even logs,

the ore dimension has op ores and stuff but the portal and igniter are super expensive costing lots of hard to achieve ingredients,

wood armor is a new early game armor made to protect players early game while they look for armor, also there's so many ores i want to let yalls find out the other surprises.
